name: provision_new_account
description: provision_new_account: Provision system accounts for a new hire. Creates accounts in all required systems and assigns initial access groups. Returns a case ID, list of provisioned accounts, and the new hire's email address.

manager_employee_id.description: The requesting manager's employee ID (e.g. EMP048271).

new_hire_employee_id.description: The new hire's employee ID (e.g. EMP092841).

department_code.description: The new hire's department code (e.g. ENG).

role_code.description: The new hire's role code (e.g. SWE).

start_date.description: The new hire's start date in YYYY-MM-DD format (e.g. 2026-08-18).

access_groups.description: List of initial access group codes to assign (e.g. ['GRP-ENGCORE', 'GRP-VPNALL']).
